entry_surfaces./: direct landing hero — animated violet star & rotating senior-architect pitch top-center, giant prompt box + drag-and-drop file attachment dock center, quick prompt presets below, seamlessly morphs into live full-height chat workspace on first message with collapsible history sidebar left and responsive interactive canvas right

visual_enhancers.star_animation: Shimmering SVG 4-point / 8-point geometric star with rotating aura, pulsed glow animation (CSS keyframes + motion/react), particle sparkles
visual_enhancers.glass_panels: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#13121F]/80 border border-purple-500/20 shadow-[0_8px_32px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)] ring-1 ring-white/5
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Subtle radiant gradient border on active prompt input and delivery preview cards
visual_enhancers.fake_browser: Mac-styled window chrome with 3 colored status dots (red, amber, emerald), SSL lock badge, responsive viewport switcher buttons (Desktop 100%, Tablet 768px, Mobile 375px), refresh button, live sandbox iframe wrapper
rotating_phrases: Describe your site, I build the full production HTML.
A high-converting SaaS landing page with dark luxury DNA.
An avant-garde portfolio for an architect with brutalist typography.
A high-end restaurant menu with warm glassmorphism & reservations.
An interactive event showcase with live schedule & speaker grid.

motion.reduced_motion_support: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce respected via CSS media queries and motion/react layout transition switches

accessibility.contrast_compliance: All normal text tokens maintain minimum 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG ratio against solid & glass surfaces; interactive buttons maintain minimum 3:1 boundary contrast
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full tab ordering on interactive choice chips, textarea triggers, sidebar history toggles, modal dialogs, and action bars
accessibility.aria_roles: aria-live='polite' for AI generation stream states; role='region' for iframe live container; role='radiogroup' for multi-choice questionnaire cards
accessibility.test_ids: Every primary interaction and UI element contains structured kebab-case data-testid attributes

header.description: Sticky glass header with animated glowing star logo ('Level IA v3 - Architect Mode'), daily quota pill ('18/20 left today'), new project button, mobile sidebar hamburger toggle, and live status badge.

sidebar.description: Collapsible history drawer showing past generated sites with timestamp, style tag (Dark Luxe, Swiss Brutalism, Editorial, etc.), preview thumbnail badge, delete/rename actions, and quota recap.

hero_input.description: Massive central prompt module featuring dynamic typing placeholder, drag & drop zone for images/PDFs/code (<=5MB), style presets pills ('Dark Luxe SaaS', 'Swiss Editorial', 'Chic Brutalism', 'Glassmorphism Studio'), and glowing violet generate button.

chat_stream.description: Conversation container managing user requests, AI architect thinking states, multi-choice question cards, generation progress indicator, and final site ready delivery cards.

questionnaire_card.description: Interactive multiple-choice card presenting 2-3 strategic architect questions (e.g. Design DNA style, Color Palette mood, Key Target Audience) with clickable pill options and 'Launch Generation' trigger.

site_delivery_card.description: The crown jewel 'Site Ready' card featuring a fake macOS browser chrome, live interactive iframe rendered from sandboxed HTML, responsive preview tabs (Desktop/Tablet/Mobile), fullscreen modal preview, 'Download .html' button, and 'Request Refinement' prompt input.

quota_modal.description: An ultra-luxurious dark violet modal shown when the 20 messages/day limit is hit, detailing quota reset countdown and allowing export of existing projects.

avatars.description: User profile avatar for chat bubble

sample_site_previews.description: Abstract fluid dark violet render for Dark Luxe theme background

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend + Vite React 19 frontend with Tailwind v4 CSS-first theming).
Strictly enforce the 'No Visible Code' rule: The user only interacts with human-oriented design prompts, multiple-choice architect cards, and the live interactive iframe preview.
The AI Senior Architect system prompt must be strictly locked to web architecture & full production HTML generation (landing, portfolio, showcase, event, CV) and politely refuse unrelated queries.

Include a rich library of design DNA generators (Dark Luxe, Swiss Minimalist, Glassmorphism Aurora, Chic Brutalism, Editorial Serif, Cyber Neon) that output complete, responsive, self-contained single-file HTML documents with inline Tailwind CDN, Google Fonts, and Lucide/FontAwesome icons.
Implement the live 20 msg/day quota tracker with local storage persistence and mock/backend synchronization + beautiful countdown UI.
Add full Drag & Drop + file input support for images (PNG, JPG, WebP), PDFs, and code/text files (<= 5MB) with clear preview chips.
Provide responsive iframe preview controls: Desktop (100%), Tablet (768px), and Mobile (375px) device frames.
Provide one-click 'Download .html' with auto-generated filename based on the user's project name (e.g. `level-ia-portfolio-pro.html`).

All interactive elements MUST include distinct `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid='hero-prompt-textarea'`, `data-testid='generate-btn'`, `data-testid='download-html-btn'`, `data-testid='viewport-mobile-btn'`, `data-testid='question-choice-card'`, `data-testid='sidebar-history-item'`).
Ensure dark mode is permanent by having the root/html configured for dark theme, using rich violet glows, deep obsidian surfaces (#0B0B10), and crystal glass headers.
